description: **PyPI publish error names both env vars.** When the PyPI publish credential is missing and no `token_var` override is configured, the error message now reads 'no PYPI_TOKEN or TWINE_PASSWORD' instead of hardcoding only PYPI_TOKEN.
**Em-dash in status warning.** `rlsbl status`'s 'commits ahead' warning now uses an em-dash separator (`— run`) instead of two hyphens (`-- run`).
